messages:
sofia: Quick follow-up: I'm sketching a background compaction plan that works across VRAM, host staging and NVMe spill. Goal: reduce tail latency spikes during big-model handoffs without stop-the-world compacts.

raj: +1 on background-only. We need a clear eligibility test so we don't thrash small-allocation workloads.

ben: Implementation sketch: per-pool compactor emits MoveOps. For live pages do copy-then-atomic-swap while holding a short soft-lease. Moves must be idempotent and observable via a MoveTicket API (pending|inflight|committed|failed).

DANA: Bandwidth note: cross-tier moves hit PCIe and NVMe. Expose migration_cost_estimate (bytes, expected_latency) from compactor so scheduler can compare benefit/cost. Honor per-tenant bandwidth caps.

raj: Estimator proposal: score = weighted_sum(fragmentation_ratio, recent_faults_per_sec, inflight_model_tokens). Only schedule when estimated_latency_gain > migration_cost_estimate * safety_factor.

ben: Example API usage:
```
move = alloc.move(addr, POOL_HOST_STAGING, {priority: "low", max_bytes: 128<<20, cost_hint: 0.035})
await move.wait_for("committed")
```
Backpressure: compactor must check nvme_queue_depth and return transient failure or delay.

sofia: Failure modes: if move fails mid-copy -> abort move, release soft-lease (pin page), emit alert, reduce concurrency and backoff. Also mark page as "retry_later" to avoid hot loops.

ben: Safety: atomic swap needs seqnum and KV-cache validation to avoid races. Order guarantees: commit must be observable, and retries should be no-op if already committed.

eviction-bot: scheduled compaction job started on gpu1 (job_id=cmp-1758888888-01)

sofia: Action items: ben: formalize MoveTicket API and idempotency rules. raj: prototype estimator and thresholds in simulator. dana: quantify cross-tier bandwidth and propose scheduler limits. infra: add metrics moved_bytes, compaction_success_rate, avg_move_latency.

raj: I'll attach a small trace when prototyping. Thanks, reconvene after the RFC patch. :thumbsup:
